summary.text: Tracy Pennycuick is a Republican state senator who has represented Pennsylvania Senate District 24, in Berks and Montgomery counties, since her election in 2022 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026. A retired U.S. Army lieutenant colonel, she chairs the Communications and Technology Committee.
Ballotpedia lists Democrat Christopher Thomas and Michael Schonewolf Jr. (G) as the other candidates.

paragraphs.text: Tracy Pennycuick served in the U.S. Army, both active and reserves, for 26 years, beginning as an enlisted combat medic, according to her official biography.
She graduated from the University of Missouri-Columbia in 1987 with a Bachelor of Science in Business Administration and a commission as an aviation officer in the Army Reserve.
After retiring as a lieutenant colonel, she started a small aviation consulting business and served three years as Montgomery County's Director of Veterans Affairs.
Before her election to the Senate, Pennycuick served in the state House representing the 147th District.

She is chair of the Communications and Technology Committee and vice chair of the Veterans Affairs and Emergency Preparedness Committee, and she is a member of the Aging and Youth, Appropriations, Finance, Judiciary, and Law and Justice committees.
She and her husband, Rick, live in Harleysville and have four grown children and two grandchildren.
